models.name: stg_waybill
models.sql:
SELECT w.waybill_id,
       w.receiver_zip AS zip,
       w.city_id
FROM waybills w
WHERE w.receiver_zip IS NOT NULL

models.name: dwd_delivery_fact
models.sql:
SELECT s.zip,
       z.zone_name,
       s.city_id
FROM stg_waybill s
JOIN dim_delivery_zone z ON s.zip = z.zip_code

models.name: ads_delivery_daily
models.sql:
SELECT f.zone_name,
       f.city_id
FROM dwd_delivery_fact f
WHERE f.city_id >= 2
